localNote: Your data stays on this computer.
syncNote: Your data is on this computer and in sync with your account.
webNote: Your data is kept in your account's own space.
leadDashboard: Your projects and your account at a glance.
leadOverview: The keywords a domain ranks for, its organic traffic and how it changes.
leadSources: Use paid data with your own API keys or with OctopusOn credits.
leadSettings: Language, AI assistants, program details and session.
leadSoon: This module arrives in this release.
soonTitle: This module is on its way
soonText: It is part of the platform's first release. Meanwhile, use the Dashboard, Domain overview, Keywords, Backlinks, Gap analysis, Rank tracking, Site audit and Sources pages.
noProjectText: Modules work with a project's domain, country and language.
errorNoSource: There is no source for this data. Enter your API key on the Sources page or connect your OctopusOn account.
errorBudget: This source's monthly budget is used up. You can change it on the Sources page.
errorQuota: Not enough balance. Buy credits or check your provider balance.
errorAccount: The OctopusOn account cannot be reached. Renew the connection on the Sources page.
closeWhileRunning: Jobs are still running; wait for them or stop them.
leadKeywords: Volume, difficulty and intent of keywords; ideas, questions, the result page and lists.
leadBacklinks: Link profile and authority (OA): backlinks, referring domains, anchors, links won and lost.
leadGap: Keywords competitors rank for and you do not, keywords where you are weaker, sites linking to competitors, and market share.
leadRank: Where your keywords rank on Google, Bing and Yandex, by city and device, daily or weekly. Visibility, competitor shares and citations in AI Overviews.
leadAudit: Crawls the site, runs 118 technical checks and measures how ready it is for AI answers (GEO); every audit is compared with the one before.
leadAi: Asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Mode the project's questions and measures how often your brand is named, whether your site is cited, and your share against rivals.
leadGsc: Reads your Search Console and Google Analytics data: queries, pages, clicks and organic sessions, joined with rank tracking and the site audit.
leadReports: Builds reports with your agency's brand from rankings, Search Console, the site audit and AI visibility; download them as PDF, Excel or HTML, and on the web share them by link or e-mail.
errorUnavailable: The data source cannot be reached right now. Try again shortly; if it keeps happening, report it to support.
reportLead: We will send this error to the OctopusOn support team. Add a few words about what you did if you like.
reportSent: Your report reached the OctopusOn support team.
leadSnapshots: Keeps the project's whole state at a moment, compares two snapshots to show what changed since the work began, and makes a white-label before/after report with a written summary.
searchPlaceholder: Search a domain, address or keyword…
leadLocal: Your business on Google Maps: its place at every point around it, the competitors in the local pack, its profile and reviews.
leadContent: Content briefs for a keyword, an editor that scores as you write, and your pages checked against the first ten results; with AI if you like.
leadProject: The project across every module, what to do first, what is coming up and this month's spending.
